reviewer: Codex light owner, actual images inspected

views.name: hull_rig
findings: The preserved two-mast mixed square/lateen arrangement, raised after deck and single open battery remain distinct in the intact whole-GLB view.
Longitudinal hull grain, shrouds/ratlines, running lines and deck fittings are visible around the broad working hull.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: At the matched 4.5 m field, the cargo opening shows a deep timber coaming, individual stair treads, rope handrails and actual lower structure through the void.
Separate staggered deck boards have fine grain/seams, while worn iron gun barrels, timber carriages and the paired mooring bitt have clear material and joinery detail.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The intact hold resolves grain/seams on the sole, curved ribs, longitudinal inner stringers, overhead beams/knees and the physical stair to the open weather-deck hatch.

Fitted planked storage with diagonal bracing and a framed glass lantern is readable beside the broad working floor; disclosed auxiliary lighting reveals construction without hiding the surrounding geometry.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The declared structural cutaway exposes the repeated frames, longitudinal inner timbers, real hatch stairs, mast structure and side-store arrangement, including actual hooped casks.
This bright wide view is supplementary to the intact material close-ups; only the manifest-listed exterior/upper timbers are hidden and the delivered GLB is unchanged.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The intact cabin shows a legged timber berth with mattress/pillow and a chart table, surrounded by fine-grained sole boards, planked bulkheads and real overhead beams/knees.
The forward doorway opens onto actual companion treads and the outside deck. The retained mast/partner structure is visible beside it, with the room legible under disclosed auxiliary lighting.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The declared cutaway exposes the actual berth, chart table and storage arrangement within the compact sole and curved afterbody frame envelope.

Inner stringers, sole edges and a small stern-light casing remain visible. Upper working-deck fittings are retained above their temporarily hidden support deck, as documented by the visibility manifest.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

limitations: Static geometry and PBR inspection only; gameplay controllers and historical exactness are not certified.
Wide cutaways are bright structural supplements; fine material grain is assessed in intact deck, hold and cabin close-ups. Every temporary hidden mesh is named in the render manifest.
Upper working-deck fittings remain at their actual positions when a support deck is temporarily hidden in a cutaway; this does not assign them to the cabin.
